description: Structured company search for portfolio building and market sizing — NOT for finding one known company (use search_companies). Filters: country, NACE prefix, status, region, turnover range (EUR), employee range, founding date range, VAT payer, tax debt, sanctions. Results are paged (limit + offset); the response says how many matched. Only the listed arguments exist — anything else is rejected, never silently ignored.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the register (e.g. SK, CZ, AT, PL). Strongly recommended: registry numbers are NOT unique across countries (an SK and a CZ company can share the same 8-digit IČO), and without it the server picks one by tie-break.

nace.description: NACE code prefix, dotted or not: division '62' (IT services, same across all markets), group '62.0' / '620', class '62.01' / '6201'. Classes are national: SK, AT, SE, SI, BE, GR and LT store NACE Rev. 2.1 since 2025, so a class filter also matches the other revision's equivalent class (62.01 also finds Rev. 2.1 62.10). An invalid code is rejected with an error, never ignored.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page.

region.description: Region name exactly as the register spells it.

sanctioned.description: Only companies with (true) / without (false) a sanctions hit.

tax_debt.description: Only companies on (true) / off (false) the tax-debtor list.

turnover_max_eur.description: Maximum latest annual turnover in EUR.

turnover_min_eur.description: Minimum latest annual turnover in EUR.
